verdict.rationale: Bitbucket explicitly markets an AI code reviewer that reviews changes and suggests fixes (bitbucket-docs-3), directly matching the story, but this is a single vendor marketing line with no detail on how it integrates into PR review flow, what models power it, or independent/hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: detailed docs on setup/configuration of the AI reviewer, examples of suggested fixes in PR UI, and independent or community corroboration of real-world use.
